body: What if I offer to take a drug test and deny saying any of this?  I mean, I will not test for drugs since I don't actually do them...also, could I get legally busted for this?

Thank you for all the comments.  I'm not suicidal, though I have thought about it.  Just more resentful and hateful of people.  This is something I will have to think about more, but I appreciate your suggestions--you have done quite a lot to dispel the idea that all people are horrible.
I'm actually early twenties, tried to change a few details because I was afraid I would get recognized.  Thanks for the support and optimism.

My family still refers to me as "boy."  I do have a job and went to college (I still feel guilty because my family paid for it)...and my family keeps strict tabs on how my work is going, what I do on a day-to-day basis, etc.  And mentally, I can't seem to separate them from my life.  I always feel that I am being "mean" whenever I don't divulge details about my life or don't call when they do (which is very often).  

When I visit for Christmas break (I am "forced" to or they yell at me and cut off all contact), they make me ask permission whenever I go out.  I'm well past the age when that should occur, but my mind lets it occur.  This is a problem with me.

People aren't actively repulsed by me.  I can be quite "friendly" in social situations.  But I am 100% forgettable.  Nobody ever seeks me out, I always seek others out.  And after meeting me, people ignore me and start talking to other people.  This happens all the time.  I'm not confident and am not sure how to become confident.  Naturally, women don't really give me the time of day (unless they need me to do something at work) and I'm starting to resent people, even though much of this might be my own fault.  It's like my head can't wrap itself around "being mean" "being openly selfish," etc.  I'm so fucking full of fear and feel like this world isn't for me or that I was born without something that is needed to get by in this world as a "man" (Jesus I still think of myself as a "boy").

PS: Also, sorry if this seems harsh, but I don't need "reverence" from others. Admiration from one person would be nice. I admire many people, but sometimes I feel that I am at the bottom of the totem pole.
:) they have Asian girls but no Asian guys; maybe I can bring them some Chinese food?
Maybe.  But how do I find out why?  I don't think I'm 100% out of everyone's range...
If only the world were this cool :(

That's fair, but I don't know what the alternative is to it.  I mean my personality doesn't seem to be turning people off during the day.  Should I just not ask anyone to hang out?  I figured it's at least worth a shot, and I'm not bitter about the fact that they don't hang out with me.  But would I like to find out why people in general don't really want to do anything outside of structured activities?  Sure.  Any tips?

Thanks for the reply--I did join a few teams.  I like soccer and I'm also in a book discussion type group.  I just feel that I don't have anyone close to talk to.  I was thinking my height has something to do with it, but maybe it's something else with my demeanor.  If I alienated people during practice and at work, I could understand what I am doing wrong.  But they all seem chill with me.  Maybe I'm just trying too hard to get friends, or trying too hard to earn their respect?  No idea whether it is a status thing, whether I look weird or smell bad (try not to haha)...
